dialog.sourcesP1: Match statistics come from {api}. From a Dotabuff URL the tool reads only the match ID. Stats are loaded from OpenDota.
dialog.sourcesP2: Availability and completeness depend on OpenDota and whether the match is public. Hidden player names may be missing. An em dash (—) means the source did not provide a value. Zero means a real zero.
dialog.sourcesP3: “Snapshot” is a stored API response with a fetch time. “Fetched from API” is the response for the current request. Data is not updated continuously. Saved matches are bookmarks in this browser only.
dialog.sourcesP4: Net worth is hero value at the end of the match. KDA = (kills + assists) / max(1, deaths). GPM / XPM are gold / XP per minute; LH / DN are last hits / denies. Kill participation = (K + A) / team kills.
dialog.sourcesP5: Hero and item dictionaries: OpenDota. Images: Valve CDN. Names and images may reflect a newer game version; historical item stats are not reconstructed here. This is an independent tool.
dialog.savedHint: Bookmarks are available in this browser. Open a match to fetch current data.
dialog.savedEmpty: No saved matches yet. Open a match and tap the bookmark icon next to its number.
dialog.noPublicId: The source did not provide a public player ID.
